'''Asset O-9''' was a member of the [[The Shroud's syndicate|intelligence network]] that served the independent operative known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. O-9 was dispatched to [[Oricon]] to investigate the demise of the [[Dread Masters]].<ref name="State" />
